settings.headline: For microblading, lip blush, and brow work.
settings.subhead: UK-formulated topical preparation for SPMU appointments. Small treatment areas, sensitive zones, longer sittings — preparation matters. Advanced Strength is the everyday recommendation. Professional for the most sustained sessions.
settings.image_alt: Editorial product close-up of Senseless cream, no faces, no procedure imagery

settings.headline: SPMU asks more from your preparation than most aesthetics.
settings.body: The treatment area is small but the work is sustained. A microblading appointment can run 90 minutes. A lip blush session can run two hours. The skin is sensitive — brows and lips both — and the pigment work doesn't pause. Advanced Strength is the everyday recommendation. Professional for the most sustained sittings, the most sensitive skin, or the longest first-time appointments. Clinical is rarely enough for this category.

settings.headline: The products built for SPMU prep.
settings.body: Cream is the format. Sustained sessions on small, sensitive areas don't suit spray.

settings.headline: A sustained session on sensitive skin earns its preparation.
settings.body: Most aesthetic appointments are short. SPMU is the exception. Sittings can run long, the treatment area is sensitive by definition, and the appointment can't be paused mid-session for a top-up. Senseless is formulated to suit the kind of preparation a microblading or lip blush appointment actually demands.
settings.image_alt: Editorial product close-up of Senseless cream

settings.headline: What comes next.
settings.body: Most aesthetic appointments end with a treated area that needs gentle handling. The Senseless Foaming Cleanser is built for the hours after. An antibacterial cleansing foam that respects what you just had done.
settings.image_alt: Editorial image of the Senseless Foaming Cleanser on a clean countertop

settings.question: Which strength is best for microblading?
settings.answer: Advanced Strength for most microblading appointments. Professional for the most sustained sittings or particularly sensitive skin. Clinical is rarely enough on its own for sustained pigment work.

settings.question: Which strength for lip blush?
settings.answer: Same recommendation — Advanced as default, Professional for longer sessions. Lips are sensitive; sustained pigment work on lips asks more from the preparation.

settings.question: Cream or gel for SPMU?
settings.answer: Cream is the default. Gel suits clients who prefer the format. Spray isn't appropriate — the treatment areas are too small.

settings.question: When do I apply it before my SPMU appointment?
settings.answer: Ahead of your appointment. Specific timing varies by artist — most SPMU artists have a recommended application window. Follow their guidance.

settings.question: Will my artist reapply during the session?
settings.answer: Many do. SPMU sittings are long enough that some artists apply additional preparation at intervals. Ask your artist about their protocol.

settings.question: Is this a medicine?
settings.answer: No. Senseless is a UK cosmetic product. Not a medicine. Not a pharmacy product.
